title: Genuinely confused at I Used To Be Funny

commenti.body:
Noah is such a well written character and this is exactly why imo. 

He is kind, sweet, and seems to truly have a lot of love and respect for Sam. He is well regarded by her friends who speak fondly of him and encourage them to reconnect. Noah is a character who is both empathetic and flawed - he acts as a great representation of how patriarchal norms / viewpoints can cause harm to those closest to us, in ways that are so normalised and subtle, we may not even realise it ourselves.

When things got dark, he lacked the perspective and emotional maturity to truly understand how to help Sam in the ways she needed - and makes no real effort to try. He puts his own feelings and ego first on multiple occasions.

Sam is rightfully hurt, but as opposed to anger, I interpreted her change in feelings toward him as more of a sad acceptance that he has more in common with the men she jokes about than she thought. 

I don’t see her closing joke as anything malicious, but rather a playful jab (which is also consistent in tone with how the circuit comedians introduce one another’s sets / interact) - as well as a way to cope around both her trauma, and loss of a relationship. I can see them laughing about it together, and think it ultimately shows she’s healing in a few areas of her life

I think it was unfortunately just a relatable joke. not just at the expense of Noah but also poking fun at the common ways of how some boyfriends react in that situation. And because it’s so relatable I don’t think it was so much a specific jab at noah. Just a relatable experience not as much a roast. And he’s such a nice guy I’m sure he gave her the okay lol. But especially the comment “why would he think that was okay” that he apologised for making, was so accurate since unfortunately a lot of boyfriends are quick to assume their girlfriends assault still somehow falls into the realm of cheating. So they’re quick to question things like “but why did he think he had a chance with you?” “Were you flirting with him” ect so I think it was so fair she could make jokes about that.
